title: fix: attribute pointer lock, keyboard lock and paste checks to the requesting frame

target.summary: FrameForLockWidget resolves the requesting frame by matching RenderWidgetHost, but in-process child frames share their parent local-root's RenderWidgetHost. Consequently, pointer lock permission requests initiated from an in-process iframe are misattributed to the parent frame rather than the requesting frame.
notes: faulty helper function that attempts to identify the requesting frame by matching RenderWidgetHost, which in-process child frames share with their parent
call site relying on FrameForLockWidget to attribute pointer lock permission requests
call site relying on FrameForLockWidget to attribute keyboard lock permission requests
